_comment: SPO resume guidelines, as data rather than code, because they are revised each cycle.
Source: knowledge-base/spo-resume-guidelines.pdf. Page references are kept on each
rule so a finding can be checked against the published document.
To update for a new cycle: copy this file, change `cycle`, edit the values, and point
SPO_GUIDELINES_PATH at it. Nothing in the code needs to change.
Setting `enabled: false` on a rule disables that check without deleting its wording,
so a rule dropped one year can be restored the next.
source: Students' Placement Office, IIT Kanpur — Resume Making Guidelines

layout._comment: Consumed by resume_structure.RelaxedResumeParser. These are SCORED on a gradient, not pass/fail.
layout._line_spacing_note: Effective line spacing: median baseline pitch divided by median font size, both measured from the document. SPO sets no spacing rule, so the band is typographic, not quoted: single spacing is ~1.2x, one-and-a-half 1.5x, double 2.0x. Above the max the page is padded; below the min lines run together.
layout._visual_weight_note: Share of the structural score taken from the visual layout reading (predict.AestheticScorer). 0.0 disables the blend and leaves the score purely geometric. Only applied when a backend actually ran.

compliance_rules._comment: Pass/fail submission policy. Deliberately NOT folded into the score.

SPO_NO_MOBILE_NUMBER.guideline: Guidelines p.1 — 'No JEE/GATE rank or mobile numbers are allowed in the submitted Master and Single page resumes.'
SPO_NO_MOBILE_NUMBER.message: A mobile number appears on the resume. SPO does not permit phone numbers on master or single-page resumes submitted through the portal.

SPO_NO_JEE_GATE_RANK.guideline: Guidelines p.1 — 'No JEE/GATE rank or mobile numbers are allowed in the submitted Master and Single page resumes.'
SPO_NO_JEE_GATE_RANK.message: A JEE/GATE rank appears on the resume. SPO does not permit it on submitted resumes.
SPO_NO_JEE_GATE_RANK._note: The scorer separately credits a JEE Advanced AIR toward academics. When both fire the finding says so, rather than silently preferring one.

SPO_PAGE_COUNT.guideline: Guidelines p.4 — 'The Technical CV should either be 1 Page or 2 Pages. The Non-Technical CV should be 1 Page Only.'

SPO_FONT_COLOUR.message: Non-black text was detected. SPO requires the entire CV to be black.
SPO_FONT_COLOUR._note: Disabled: colour is used in practice for links, section rules and accents, and flagging it produced a finding on resumes nobody considers non-compliant. 0-255 per channel; re-enable if a cycle enforces the guideline literally.

SPO_FONT_FAMILY_COUNT.guideline: Guidelines p.4 — 'Use only one Font in the complete CV.'
SPO_FONT_FAMILY_COUNT.message: More font families are in use than the guidelines permit.

SPO_PREFERRED_FONT.guideline: Guidelines p.4 — 'Preferred Fonts: Times New Roman, Garamond, Tahoma, Verdana, Book Antiqua, Courier New, Calibri, Cambria, Palatino Linotype, Arial'.
SPO_PREFERRED_FONT.message: The document uses a font outside the preferred list.
SPO_PREFERRED_FONT._note: Disabled by default: the SPO does not restrict template choice, and LaTeX Computer Modern is widely accepted in practice. Enable if a cycle enforces the list.

SPO_CPI_MANDATORY.guideline: Guidelines p.2 — 'It is compulsory to mention your Pingala CPI in the Academic Qualification section.'
SPO_CPI_MANDATORY.message: No Pingala CPI was found in the academic qualifications section. Stating it there is compulsory.

SPO_EDUCATION_TABLE_ROWS.guideline: Guidelines p.1 — 'This section should have your CPI, 12th, and 10th scores.'

SPO_EDUCATION_SCORES.guideline: Guidelines p.1 — 'This section should have your CPI, 12th, and 10th scores.'
SPO_EDUCATION_SCORES._note: The row existing is not the same as the score being stated; this checks the mark itself is present.

SPO_EDUCATION_CHRONOLOGY.guideline: Guidelines p.6 — 'The content in the table should be in reverse chronological order.'
SPO_EDUCATION_CHRONOLOGY.message: The education table is not in reverse chronological order.

SPO_ACHIEVEMENT_YEAR.guideline: Guidelines p.6 — "Any 'Achievements' or 'Activities': Definitely mention the year of Activity or Achievement."

SPO_SELF_PROJECT_LABEL.guideline: Guidelines p.3 — 'Projects done at an individual level will have to be clearly stated as "Self Projects" in the resume if mentioned.'

SPO_ONGOING_LABEL.guideline: Guidelines p.3 — 'In case of an ongoing project/internship, you can mention that on your resume - explicitly mentioning that it is "ongoing".'
SPO_ONGOING_LABEL.message: An in-progress engagement is listed. SPO asks that ongoing work be explicitly marked 'ongoing'.
